description: This file defines functions for extracting and processing system prompt data, including parsing skill blocks, building tool entries, and generating a system prompt report for a session. It references external types and modules related to agent tools, session reports, and workspace files.

methods.name: extractBetween
methods.description: Extracts a substring between two markers within a string.

methods.name: parseSkillBlocks
methods.description: Parses skill blocks from a prompt string, extracting skill names and block sizes.

methods.name: buildToolsEntries
methods.description: Builds an array of tool entry summaries from a list of AgentTool objects.

methods.name: extractToolListText
methods.description: Extracts the list of tool names from a system prompt string.

methods.name: buildSystemPromptReport
methods.description: Generates a report object summarizing the system prompt, tools, skills, and context for a session.
